description: We are a team of passionate and curious innovators interested in space science, artificial intelligence, technology and real-world problem-solving. We aim to explore NASA's open data, develop creative solutions and transform innovative ideas into meaningful projects. We welcome enthusiastic teammates with interests in programming, AI/ML, data analysis, research, design and creative thinking. Let's collaborate, learn and build something impactful together!
summary: Mission Forge is an interactive space mission design game developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It provides an engaging virtual environment where players can experience the fundamentals of spacecraft construction, mission planning, and space exploration. The platform features an interactive 3D spacecraft and planetary visualization combined with a mission-control interface. Players can assemble spacecraft using different components, manage mission resources and budgets, perform preflight checks, execute engine burns, progress through orbital operations, and complete landing and research beacon deployment activities. By combining interactive gameplay with simplified space mission concepts, Mission Forge aims to make space exploration more accessible, engaging, and educational. It encourages players to understand the challenges of designing and executing space missions through hands-on experimentation and simulated mission operations.
details: Mission Forge is an interactive space mission design and exploration simulator developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project transforms space mission planning into an engaging, hands-on gaming experience through a combination of interactive 3D visualization and a mission-control interface. Players can construct spacecraft using different components, manage budgets and resources, perform preflight checks, execute engine burns, progress through orbital operations, complete landing activities, and deploy research beacons. The platform provides a simplified simulation of mission operations, helping users understand the fundamental challenges involved in spacecraft design and space exploration. Mission Forge was developed using React, Vite, JavaScript, and Three.js for interactive 3D rendering, with Lucide React for interface icons. The application is hosted publicly through Vercel. The project aims to make space exploration concepts more accessible, encourage experimentation, and inspire interest in aerospace engineering, planetary exploration, and scientific discovery through interactive gameplay.
